title: 新加坡拟推数据中心云服务许可新规
titleEn: Singapore considers new licensing rules for data centres and cloud services
summary: 新加坡推进新的数据中心许可规则,要求加强安全措施和应急准备。超过一半的数据中心将受新规影响。
summaryEn: Singapore is introducing new licensing rules for data centres and cloud services to enhance security. Over half of the nation's data centres will be subject to the new regulations.
speaker: CNA
